name: emu-heltec-oled
description: One Virtual Heltec firmware node (SSD1306 128x64 OLED profile, GPS-capable) on the ether. Uses the Heltec/OLED node binary (emulator/node/build-heltec/bramble-node.elf) instead of the e-paper pager, so the emulator streams a 128x64 monochrome framebuffer. A single node keeps screen navigation deterministic for the heltec-oled e2e capture: it never receives a message, so nothing auto-switches its screen out from under the button-driven walk through Main / Messages / Nodes / Stats / GPS / Settings. It still autosends a broadcast (stored in its own message log) so the Messages screen has content, and its GPS gate opens so the broker feeds it a fix for the GPS screen. Build the node binary first: emulator/scripts/build_node_heltec.sh.
